# PassorMatch

> PassorMatch is a dating platform focused on Thailand, connecting verified Thai locals and foreigners for genuine relationships. Profiles are ID-verified, with anti-scam moderation, translation support, and free registration.

PassorMatch helps foreigners and locals meet in Thailand through a verified dating app, alongside a library of guides on Thai dating culture, safety, and city-specific dating advice.

## Dating App Guides

- [Best Dating Apps in Thailand](https://passormatch.com/blog/best-dating-apps-thailand.html): Comparison of Tinder, ThaiFriendly, Bumble, and PassorMatch for Thailand.
- [Best Dating Apps in Bangkok](https://passormatch.com/blog/bangkok-dating-guide.html): Which app works best by Bangkok neighborhood (Sukhumvit, Thonglor, Ari, Silom).
- [Dating Apps in Thailand for Foreigners](https://passormatch.com/blog/dating-apps-thailand-foreigners.html): Language, culture, and safety considerations for foreigners.
- [Thai Dating Apps Explained](https://passormatch.com/blog/thai-dating-apps.html): Local Thai apps vs. international apps like Tinder, and how verification differs.
